title: Robbery
grade_or_penalty: 2nd degree; 1st degree if the actor attempts to kill, inflicts or attempts serious bodily injury, or is armed or threatens use of a deadly weapon
key_points: Inflicting bodily injury, using force, threatening immediate bodily injury, or threatening to commit a 1st or 2nd degree crime in the course of committing a theft.
Course of theft includes the attempt and immediate flight.
elements: The suspect was in the course of committing a theft (including attempt and immediate flight)
The suspect inflicted bodily injury or used force; OR threatened or purposely put the victim in fear of immediate bodily injury; OR committed or threatened a 1st or 2nd degree crime
For 1st degree: attempted to kill, inflicted or attempted serious bodily injury, or was armed with or threatened use of a deadly weapon

subsections.label: a(1)
subsections.text: In the course of a theft, inflicts bodily injury or uses force upon another

subsections.label: a(2)
subsections.text: Threatens another with, or purposely puts them in fear of, immediate bodily injury

subsections.label: a(3)
subsections.text: Commits or threatens immediately to commit a 1st or 2nd degree crime

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: 1st degree if the actor attempts to kill, purposely inflicts or attempts serious bodily injury, or is armed with, uses or threatens a deadly weapon
